name: Short Blink
summary: Move a few feet to a visible, unoccupied position within the current scene.
limits: Cannot cross a sealed barrier or leave the current scene.
Cannot create or travel through a void-rift.

name: Rift Sight
summary: Perceive active dimensional residue and nearby weak points within the current scene.
limits: Does not reveal protected campaign truth or events outside the current perspective.
Provides perception only and cannot open or control a rift.

name: Silent Movement
summary: Suppress ordinary sound created by the user's own movement.
limits: Does not silence other creatures, speech, impacts, alarms, or the surrounding area.
Does not make the user invisible.

name: Heat Siphon
summary: Draw heat from a touched object or small nearby source while contact is maintained.
limits: Cannot instantly freeze a living target or extinguish a district-scale fire.
Combat damage and environmental extremes require their dedicated rules.

name: Force Shield
summary: Maintain a small personal barrier against an immediate physical threat.
limits: Numeric defense and damage reduction remain unavailable until combat rules exist.
Cannot protect an entire location or remain active after unconsciousness.

name: Phase Walk
summary: Become partially intangible while moving through a bounded part of the current scene.
limits: Cannot bypass a containment boundary, leave Velmora, or enter a void-rift.
Cannot end while occupying solid matter and ends on unconsciousness.

name: World Anchor
summary: Temporarily suppress teleportation, phasing, and unstable rift movement in the current scene.
limits: Cannot close the central Tear or permanently seal a void-rift.
Permanent acquisition requires an approved opportunity, explicit player choice, and player approval.
